environment.description: AWS Lambda function with Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy contains a principal condition restricting invoke access to role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/PreferencesAPICallerRole only. The account has an SCP (Service Control Policy) attached at the OU level that includes a Deny statement on lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl for any principal not matching the condition key lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType=AWS_IAM. The EventBridge config-sync rule was removed during last quarter's security review (JIRA SEC-4421). SSM parameter /app/config/overrides has a resource policy restricting PutParameter to the platform-admin role which requires MFA session context.

config.ssm_parameter_resource_policy: Deny PutParameter unless principal=platform-admin AND aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent=true
